title: Transfer of UFO material from Lockheed Martin to Bigelow Aerospace
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Transfer of UFO material from Lockheed Martin to Bigelow Aerospace, about 2000s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Lockheed Martin / Bigelow Aerospace, United States

tellings.quote: this transfer of UFO material from Loheed Martin using some sort of uh special access program to Bigalow Aerospace.

OSAP was originally intended to skip out Bigalow Aerospace facilities in Las Vegas due to a UAP material divestment plan proposal to OAP leadership by Loheed Martin space systems vice president Dr. James Ryder now deceased.
tellings.difference: Calls it a divestment plan proposal to OSAP leadership, ~2008, and notes Ryder is deceased.

as_told.title: James Ryder's UAP material divestment proposal to OSAP

as_told.title: Kona Blue and a Lockheed-to-Bigelow material transfer

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that UFO material held by Lockheed Martin, a major US defence company, was moved to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company in Las Vegas owned by Bob Bigelow, through a special access program, a tightly restricted secret government project. In one telling, Michels says the plan came from Dr. James Ryder, a Lockheed vice president who has since died, and that it shaped OSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained aerial reports. In another he puts it next to Kona Blue, a programme he also counts as a real UFO programme. If true, it would mean a defence company held recovered UFO material and passed it on to a private firm.
